## 更新内容

- 补充 ChatGPT 布局中的文字对齐、宽高属性及说明文字支持；链接组件转换为普通 Markdown 链接。
- SVG 图示及其中的模板循环以明确标注的源码块保留，暂不渲染为图片，避免其阻断整段对话保存。
- 保留代码示例、图片本地化、本地编辑保护及未知 HTML 检查。

通过 BRAT 更新 `elfmedy/obsidian-ai-inbox`。本次浏览器端 HTML 捕获修复需要 [浏览器扩展 0.5.5](https://github.com/elfmedy/browser-ai-inbox/releases/tag/0.5.5)；请重新加载扩展并刷新聊天页面。无需删除笔记或重新配对。

兼容扩展 0.3.0+ 的 ChatGPT 保存请求；Gemini / Claude 需要扩展 0.5.0+。

## What's new

- Support additional ChatGPT text-alignment and sizing attributes, captions, and literal link components.
- Retain SVG diagrams and template loops as clearly labelled source blocks, without rendering or executing them, so they no longer block the conversation save.
- Preserve code examples, local image handling, local-edit protection and checks for unknown HTML.

Update through BRAT and install [browser extension 0.5.5](https://github.com/elfmedy/browser-ai-inbox/releases/tag/0.5.5) for this capture fix. Reload the extension and refresh the chat. Keep existing notes and pairing.

Compatible with extension 0.3.0+ for ChatGPT and 0.5.0+ for Gemini / Claude.

Alpha · Desktop Obsidian 1.12.0+ · Manual installation: `main.js` and `manifest.json`.
